hideEmptyRootGroups: Hide empty root sections and sections inside Common in configurations and extensions by default. Groups inside objects remain visible. A saved project choice overrides this setting; use Use Default Filter to reset it.
executable: Executable name or absolute path without arguments. The default uses eska-project; legacy mode uses eska when the default is unchanged. A custom path is kept and its identity is checked.
trust: Explorer runs a local backend executable and requires a trusted workspace.
virtual: Explorer requires project files on the extension host filesystem.
treeLanguage: Language of metadata groups, module roles and search result types. Auto follows the VS Code language (Russian or English). Applies immediately; object names and other UI text are unchanged.
revealActiveFile: Reveal Active File in eska Tree
checkForUpdates: Check for global ESKA updates at most once a day. Installation requires confirmation.
supportPolicy: Check 1C support rules on demand and open locked sources in protected read-only tabs, including ordinary unchanged file tabs. Preserve unsaved text with removable read-only settings. Disabling removes only ESKA restrictions. Applies to all workspace folders.
backend: Metadata backend. Project runs eska-project serve; legacy explicitly uses eska ide without changing your configured path.
backendLegacy: Legacy eska ide, Metadata API 1.11; shown with a warning
analyzerExecutable: Path or command name of the published bsl-analyzer-app. Explicit binaries are never overwritten.
checkForAnalyzerUpdates: Check Analyzer releases at most once per day on this workspace host. Independent of ESKA update checks.
